propositions: sign-review's baseline collect aborts terminally on transient store-read-failure raised by a concurrent writer's staged index, despite sign_manifest already having a retry fix for the same race

resign_plan_review must wrap its generation.collect in a bounded retry loop (MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS with jittered backoff) mirroring sign_manifest's pattern, catching only transient store-read-failure reasons and leaving deterministic PlanRelationSnapshotError reasons terminal

transient store-read-failure during resign's baseline collect should be retried up to MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS before surfacing as a structured retry-after-repair refusal advising the caller to retry sign-review
deterministic PlanRelationSnapshotError reasons (missing, ambiguous, malformed, reducer, id-mismatch) must remain terminal on the first attempt with no retry
